annual.note: 20-F is prepared under IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the IASB; the Q1/Q2 2026 6-Ks and the Feb 25 2026 6-K (accession 0001193125-26-068366) use Taiwan-endorsed IFRS (TIFRS), under which the Dec 31 2025 balance sheet differs: equity-method investments NT$48,642,917 thousand (vs 36,869,092 in 20-F), total equity NT$379,855,440 thousand (vs 365,912,172), no treasury stock (20-F: NT$9,803,778 thousand for UMC shares held by associates, 900.9 million shares per Note 6(19)b). Revenue (237,553,199) and operating income (43,948,688) are identical on both bases. This snapshot uses the 20-F as filed. Debt = short-term loans + bonds (incl. exchangeable bonds at redemption amount, net of aggregate discount) + long-term loans; IFRS 16 lease liabilities are reported in operatingLeaseLiabilities and excluded from debt. Short-term investments include current FVTPL, FVOCI and amortized-cost (time deposit) assets. Long-term investments include noncurrent FVTPL/FVOCI and equity-method investments (carrying value, not fair value). Guarantee deposits (customer capacity deposits, NT$39,805,928 thousand noncurrent) are NOT included in debt. UMC has no stock options or warrants; employee restricted stock awards are issued shares already counted in sharesOutstanding (unvested count not disclosed, so unvestedRSUs is null). Exchangeable bond carrying equals the note-table redemption amount; the aggregate bond discount is not allocated by instrument.

ttm.note: Balance sheet, H1 2026 and H1 2025 flows come from the Q2 2026 6-K (Exhibit 99.1, TIFRS-basis, reviewed not audited); the 6-K main document is a cover page (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1033767/000119312526322030/2026q2_quarterly_reports.htm), the statements are in Exhibit 99.1. FY2025 annual flows come directly from the TIFRS annual report (6-K 0001193125-26-068366, Feb 25 2026, Exhibit 99.1); all three TTM flow components are TIFRS. The separate annual-reference base and annual history remain IASB IFRS. Basis difference: the 20-F balance sheet uses IASB IFRS (UMC shares held by associates treated as treasury stock, lower equity-method carrying), the 6-K uses TIFRS; this affects equity-method carrying (June 30 2026 NT$96,474,468 thousand includes Hsun Chieh at NT$34,229,937 thousand vs NT$12,792,773 thousand at Dec 31 2025 per Q2 6-K Note 6(7)) and equity, not revenue or operating income. H1 2026 includes non-operating gains of NT$26.4bn from associates and NT$8.2bn FVTPL gains, all below operating income and excluded here. Debt excludes IFRS 16 leases (operatingLeaseLiabilities), excludes guarantee deposits (customer capacity deposits NT$40,045,045 thousand, Note 6(28)) and excludes the declared dividend (shown in otherClaims). Treasury shares (30.551 million) are excluded from sharesOutstanding. UMC has no stock options or warrants; restricted stock awards are issued shares already counted. The exchangeable bonds convert into NOVATEK shares held by UMC and matured 2026-07-07 (after period end). ADS ratio: one ADS = five ordinary shares (Note 6(19)a(ii), 20-F cover); 147 million ADSs outstanding at Jun 30 2026.

notes: All amounts are NT$ millions (statements are in NT$ thousands); share counts in millions of ordinary shares; per-ADS value = per-ordinary-share value x 5.

Annual snapshot is from the IASB-basis 20-F; TTM balance sheet is from the TIFRS-basis 6-K; see snapshot notes for the equity-method/treasury-stock basis difference. Revenue and operating income agree on both bases.
Latest filed interim before 2026-10-20 is the Q2 2026 six-month report (6-K filed 2026-07-29); Q3 2026 statements are not yet filed.

The data.sec.gov companyfacts feed for UMC did not return the income statement or balance sheet line items checked, so all figures were verified against the filed HTML documents and evidence is by statement/note locator (tag given only where the IFRS tag is standard, not confirmed in the feed).
